call_points.text: Ex-US markets grew 17% YoY to ₹5,875m ($63m), led by UK, Nordics and Africa brands.
Slower-than-expected quota allocation is impacting Controlled Substances revenue growth.
EBITDA grew 5.4% YoY to ₹2,298m despite ~₹131m freight and operating cost impact from geopolitical disruption.
EcoVadis sustainability score improved to 68/100, a 19-point increase over last year.
228 ANDAs filed, 210 approved (152 products) as of June 2026; second nasal spray product filed in May 2026.

penalties.details: Penalty of Rs. 10,000 imposed in relation to an alleged shortfall in fulfilment of export obligations pertaining to FY 2019-20 by Strides Alathur Private Limited, former wholly-owned subsidiary of Strides, which merged with Strides effective September 12, 2024. Additionally, the name of Strides Alathur is included in the Denied Entity List (DEL) maintained by DGFT. Further the order states that no further licenses / authorizations/ export incentives shall be granted to the licensee and to its Director(s) and to other business entities in which they are directly involved in the capacity of Proprietor/ Propreitrix/ Partners)/ Director(s).
penalties.impact: Penalty of Rs. 10,000/- has been paid by the Company. Further, Strides has filed an appeal before the Additional Director General of Foreign Trade seeking withdrawal of all the charges in the Order including penalty imposed. Based on current assessment, there is no financial or material impact on the operational or financial activities of Strides.

guidance.statement: Aspire to focus on North America Business Revenue of ~$375m by FY28 despite current external headwinds
New product approvals are expected in H2FY27

operating_notes.text: US revenue was $68m in Q1FY27, steady YoY despite new entrants in recent launches; 72 commercialised products, 2 launched in the quarter.
228 ANDAs filed and 210 approved (152 products) as of June 2026; second nasal spray product filed in May 2026.
Net debt/EBITDA at 1.52x with operating cash flow of ₹1,087m in Q1FY27; cash-to-cash cycle 123 days.
